items.zh: 补齐三协议工具与结构化输出转换，保留图片 detail、同协议参数、引用注解及拒绝结构，修复 SSE 分帧与最终快照恢复
items.en: Improved tool and structured-output conversion across three protocols; preserved image detail, native options, annotations and refusal structures; fixed SSE framing and final snapshot recovery

items.zh: 任务支持自定义时区，默认北京时间；时区与每日随机偏移统一保存，手机端也可操作
items.en: Task scheduling now supports configurable timezones, defaulting to Asia/Shanghai, with a shared save action for timezone and daily jitter on desktop and mobile

items.zh: 统一固定页头、内容滚动与底部分页，补齐账号、实例、分组、代理、路由、密钥、凭证及插件列表分页
items.en: Consistent fixed headers, scrolling content and pagination, with pagination added to accounts, instances, groups, proxies, routes, keys, OAuth credentials and installed plugins

items.zh: 修复流式响应中断、工具调用与取消处理，网关继续兼容旧插件
items.en: Fixes for interrupted streams, tool calls and cancellation while preserving gateway compatibility with older plugins

items.zh: 完善凭据加密、密钥授权与登录会话管理，增强插件安装及备份恢复可靠性
items.en: Improved credential encryption, API key permissions and login session management, with more reliable plugin installation and backup restore

items.zh: 修复登录表单间距和任务调度阻塞，发布构建支持 SQLite 并复用前端产物
items.en: Fixes for login form spacing and blocked task scheduling; release builds enable SQLite support and reuse the web build
